rv.q: The music and lyrics by George Howe and Ed Rutherford, along with the direction from Anthony Whitaker, make this musical parody a sparkling one.
The witty writing team of Ed Rutherford (book & lyrics) and George Howe (music & lyrics) have given Chicago audiences a world premier to die for!
Rutherford and Howe manage to ingratiate both the original show's die-hard fans as well as the uninitiated.
Lovingly written by Ed Rutherford, with music by George Howe and lyrics by Rutherford and Howe, the show is a stroke of genius!
